package.name: 3D Print Exporter
package.description: Export the selection to 3MF and apply build-plate operations through lib3mf, driven by Python hook scripts. Instead of hand-writing vertices/triangles XML, geometry goes through lib3mf's typed API; hooks receive a rich context (selection, lib3mf model, helpers) so you can, e.g., align a selected face/plane to the build plate or drop the part on the bed.
package.author: Yuval Dikerman
